paragraphs.text: Haaach is a criminal goblin berserker from Alara who became wanted on Naya . He has been known as Haaach of the Bloodhall , The Hackblade , What the Hell Was That? , and The Piranha of Valeron .

He has been wanted for twelve infractions of Bant war laws - including three aggravated prayer violations and five instances of dishonorable initiation of force outside the lawful hours of wartime, possession of a stolen weapon, assault with a jagged golden sword, and speeding.

Haaach is said to have come from the warren of Jund goblins that originate from the Bloodhall , one of Jund's deepest geothermic cavern systems, whose hot underworld supports an ecosystem of scaly black insects and immense carnivorous oozes . Haaach is known for his ferocity and speed in battle going so far as to carve up and devour the prime parts of a fallen rockwurm before it had even stopped breathing.

He became known when he stormed across Naya. While there he obtained an ancient ceremonial dagger originating from a jungle shrine near Qasal . In response, the Nacatl prides posted a bounty for its safe return. He was last seen at the Battle of the Bloody Gate in Valeron , where he is believed to have been killed and partially ate over twenty neophyte soldiers.
